title: VerySimpleCraft
description: Mod that makes game easier for noobies
body:
The mod will make the game easier for beginners. 
- Afraid of drowning?
   Don't be, because you can't swim anymore. 
- Are you worried about your rabbits? 
  Don't worry, they can stand up for themselves now. 
- Afraid to stop being a vegan? 
  Great, now the tempting meat will turn into rot so it won't bother you. 
- And so on.
